note: What a community's values suggest for how it admits members. Up to 3 recommendations per value (a small number of values have 4 where the links are all strong). All items need_review before use. strength: how strongly the value argues for (+1, +2) or against (−1, −2) the option; it adds to or takes from the option's score in suggestions (js/recommend.js). Only status "accepted" is used (proposed ones are previewed while in review).
